sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND (COALESCE(((SELECT avg(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $5::text)) = 'number' THEN CASE WHEN abs(((e.properties -> $5::text))::numeric) <= 1e300 THEN ((e.properties -> $5::text))::float8 END END) FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at > $3::timestamptz AND e.occurred_at <= $4::timestamptz) > $6::float8), false))
